'''Skeletons''' in [[Ullek]] play a small role in the [[Dealing with Scabaras]] quest. They are located in the raised area near [[Lead archaeologist Abigail]], along with [[dried zombie]]s and [[mummy|mummies]]. Their location is affected by [[desert heat]]. These skeletons can be killed for [[Scabarite notes]] to complete the [[Scabarites Notes]] miniquest.

{{UH|

** Retiered existing Shortbows, Longbows, Crossbows and 2h Crossbows. Drop tables and shop inventory containing items that have been retiered, where appropriate, are replaced with the new item for that range level instead.
*** Yew shortbow → Maple shortbow

* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Magic ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Melee ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Ranged ('strong'): 45 → 50
